name: Axe Accessibility Scanner
description: WCAG accessibility testing using axe-core engine. Detects accessibility violations and provides remediation guidance.
author: Stageflow

configSchema.description: Only the options below affect analysis. Unrecognized historical settings are accepted but ignored.

disabledRules.description: Specific axe rules to disable (empty = no disabled rules)

runOnlyTags.description: Limit analysis to rules with these axe tags (empty = all rules)

dynamicContentWaitMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for dynamic content before analysis (0 skips the wait)
